---
title: "Why this space?"
author: "Abey Sushan"
date: "2025-06-17"
categories: [news]
---

I have tried all platforms to try and document what I find interesting... tumblr, blogger, wordpress... But the tinkerer in me was never satisfied. He was always on the look-out for something else to tinker with. This too, is one such effort. But this time, there is a difference. 

While the earlier ones were vain efforts at self actualization, this space has a goal. I want to nurture this space as a place to document the few things I find interesting -- mostly in the public health domain of India, but not exclusively. 

![](thumbnail.jpg)

May be it will turn out to be a public health digest, I don't know yet. But I am here to see where this leads.

::: {.callout-note}
This space is not intended to be educational.
:::
